_comment: Example for multi_chaser.py --config. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Everything not listed here has the default shown in the README. Remember to tune each first!

control_channels._comment: SDR #1: one SDR listening to every control channel at once. They must all fit inside its sample-rate window.

chaser._comment: SDR #2: retuned to each data channel. start_frequency is where it waits until the first grant: "auto" (the average of the control channels) or a frequency.

policy._comment: Which radios to chase. One or more LO-HI ranges (empty = everyone).

paths._comment: op25_dir is the OP25 apps/ directory (where rx.py and multi_rx.py live). Relative paths are relative to where you start multi_chaser.py.
